newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee trading below 35.70 against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee trading below 35.70 against dollar.

text.p: The rupee was trading below the 35.70 per dollar mark in early Monday deals and looked set to appreciate further, dealers said.
The rupee opened the day steady at 35.695/705.
"There were no deals at 35.70 today," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers said the 35.70 barrier had been expected to hold, given the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) intervention last week.
Early Monday inter-bank deals were at 35.6950/55 rupees to a dollar, dealers said.
"There have been stray deals at 35.6925 also," said a dealer.
The rupee could touch the 35.68 level unless the RBI bought dollars, dealers said.
The central bank last week intrervened only in afternoon trade, at times just before close of trade, dealers said.
